changelog: **Language switcher on the partner pages (#3465):** `/partner` and `/partner/apply` carry the shared `LanguageSwitcher`, and the header links no longer break onto two lines on a phone. The marketing demo seed now fills the TR and DE steps, contact text and call-to-action of the programme page, which used to fall back to English.

en: Visitors can switch the language of the partner programme page and its application form.
tr: Ziyaretçiler partner programı sayfasının ve başvuru formunun dilini değiştirebilir.
de: Besucher können die Sprache der Partnerprogramm-Seite und des Bewerbungsformulars wechseln.
